findings.message: Scope in says to replace the three heartbeat-file waits in test_serve_notify.py with a wrapper that counts rig.owner.maintenance calls. In the restart half of test_serve_reconciles_notifications_at_startup_and_poll, the old wait needed a new heartbeat mtime, which meant at least one maintenance cycle after restart.
